mapper.select: SELECT o.distributor_id FROM orders_rel_chinaumspay_division reldivision INNER JOIN orders_normal_orders o ON reldivision.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.company_id = #{companyId} AND reldivision.status = '0' AND o.order_auto_close_aftersales_time <= #{now} GROUP BY o.distributor_id

SELECT reldivision.id, reldivision.order_id, reldivision.company_id, o.total_fee, o.distributor_id FROM orders_rel_chinaumspay_division reldivision INNER JOIN orders_normal_orders o ON reldivision.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.distributor_id = #{distributorId} AND reldivision.status = '0' AND o.order_auto_close_aftersales_time <= #{now}
